{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if recent true outcomes show strong upward momentum (e.g., >65.00) to avoid premature peak predictions.",
    "Apply a 5-10% downward correction to forecasts following sharp spikes (>65.00) to prevent overshoot and align with mean reversion.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00), slightly increase forecast volatility to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at +10% above recent mean.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, apply a smoothing filter (e.g., 3-point moving average) to reduce noise and align with historical mean reversion patterns.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., >10% underperformance), reduce forecast by 5-10% to reflect underestimation bias.",
    "In periods of high volatility (e.g., 3-5 consecutive days with >10% price swings), reduce forecast confidence and apply a ±5% buffer to avoid overfitting."
  ]
}
